SILLIMAN HAPPENINGS | HALLOWEEN WEEK

Around campus this week, sent along by your peers:

HALLOWOADS at Toad's Place
Wed Oct 28, 10:00pm, Toad's Place of New Haven, 300 York St. Yale ID required. GA $18.75 + fees.

Monster Mash 2026: Camp Crystal Queer (Yale LGBTQ Center)
Fri Oct 30, 9:00-11:30pm, 135 Prospect St. Costume contest. Volunteers wanted.

Good Show sketch comedy
Fri Oct 30, 8:00pm. Featuring an original sketch by YCT's Polly.

Have something for next week's Happenings? Reply to this email by Sunday.
